_description: Live quest state. known_to_party=false quests and all secret_truth/obstacles fields are hidden from the web companion.

active.title: Hold the Long Wall
active.given_by: Captain Brunna Stonehewn, commander of Kraghold
active.summary: The Red Howl warband has the pass corked and probes Kraghold's outer wall every night — wolf-riders testing for the weak stone. The hold's shields are too few. Brunna is paying steel-rate for anyone who can stand a bastion until the thaw opens the road, or the siege breaks.
objectives: Throw back the night probes on the Long Wall
Find how the raiders cross the open scree unseen
Break the siege before the granary runs dry
active.obstacles: Wolf-riders strike and vanish; the scree below the wall shows no tracks; stores are counted in weeks.
active.secret_truth: The Red Howl aren't conquering — they're fleeing. Something old is waking deeper in the range (a frost wyrm; rescale freely) and has driven them into the pass. They cross the scree through goat tunnels their shamans found — tunnels that connect to the same under-road Kraghold's sealed Deep Door guards. Kill the warband and the wyrm's problem remains; parley, and the Red Howl know exactly what's coming. Scale and reskin freely.
active.rewards: Steel-rate pay (10 gp/week each), pick of the armory, and Kraghold's shield-oath — dwarves remember

hooks.title: The Sortie
hooks.pitch: The raiders are building ladders in the tree line. Brunna wants a night crew to go out and burn them.
hooks.summary: GM: commando mission — stealth in, fight out. First clear look at how organized (and how scared) the Red Howl actually are.

hooks.title: The Champion's Challenge
hooks.pitch: Each dawn a scarred wolf-rider rides the scree and bellows a challenge at the wall. Nobody has answered it.
hooks.summary: GM: single combat, formal rules, warband honor. Winning earns a parley channel; refusing costs the wall's morale.

hooks.title: The Deep Door
hooks.pitch: The sealed gate in Kraghold's cellar has started thudding at night, from the other side.
hooks.summary: GM: the under-road. Opens the dungeon leg of the campaign and the truth about what drives the Red Howl. Don't open it before the table's ready.
